project.description:
One class: the channel by which a seam tells a consumer it has silently dropped something the consumer asked for.
It exists because the failures that cost a real application the most were not the ones that threw. A technique handed a coloured surface it cannot colour, a capture handed an image from another device, a charset asking for glyphs the font does not have — each produces a plausible picture, and a plausible picture is indistinguishable from a taste decision. Making each of those say so is one boolean and one line; making five of them say so the same way, across three modules, is this.
Depends on atchung-probe alone, which every module already reaches and which has no dependencies of its own: a dropped capability is a WARN in the stack's one log (see atchung/docs/logging.md), so it reaches the file as well as the console. Deliberately not in vexelray-core: nothing depends on that module today, and pulling FrameGraph and its neighbours in for one utility would be the wrong trade for the modules that need this most.
